items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: they would call him and there was a pianist named Franklin Haweksberry, and he was a concert pianist, and he would accompany Fred Griffin on these cornet solos

ctx.x: You got some discipline out of that I would imagine.

He was a tremendous player though, because at one of the radio stations, I think it was WPEN or WCAU, I’m not sure which it was, but at any rate, they would have a period during which they had no scheduling of any commercial thing or something, and they’d just have a time slot that they had nothing to fill it in with, and they would call him and there was a pianist named Franklin Haweksberry, and he was a concert pianist, and he would accompany Fred Griffin on these cornet solos, and the network would call and…
That’s interesting. Those days are pretty much gone of someone coming in and playing live for an hour.
